svg.title: Recursion & the Call Stack
svg.desc: Recursion & the Call Stack. A function calls itself on a smaller input; each call waits on the stack until a base case returns and the answers unwind. Step 1, Calls go down: fact(4), fact(3) and fact(2) each reach the recursive case and wait (purple) under a smaller call. Step 2, Base case, then unwind: fact(1) hits the base case and returns 1; frames pop one by one: 2 × 1, 3 × 2, then 4 × 6 = 24. Step 3, Branching repeats work: Naive fib(5) makes 15 calls and 9 of them redo earlier work; a memo cuts it to 6 computations. Step 4, Too deep: RecursionError: fact(5000) needs 5000 frames, but CPython stops at 1000 with RecursionError. A loop needs one.

g.text: fact(4), fact(3) and fact(2) each reach the recursive case and wait (purple) under a smaller call.
fact(1) hits the base case and returns 1; frames pop one by one: 2 × 1, 3 × 2, then 4 × 6 = 24.
Naive fib(5) makes 15 calls and 9 of them redo earlier work; a memo cuts it to 6 computations.
fact(5000) needs 5000 frames, but CPython stops at 1000 with RecursionError. A loop needs one.
n <= 1: answer directly, no more calls
call itself on a smaller input: n - 1
memo: each fib(n) stored the first time it returns
every pending call keeps a frame
fact(n) needs n frames: O(n) stack
endless calls: the same error at any limit
for tree-shaped work: push, pop, loop
tail call? no help in Python
CPython does not eliminate tail calls
naive calls grow about 1.6× per extra n: Θ(φⁿ), φ ≈ 1.618
